patterns.note: Full-width sections with content centered within a consistent maximum width, creating clear visual blocks for different information.
Key headings and value propositions use a large, bold sans-serif font for strong emphasis, contrasting with a lighter weight sans-serif for body text.
Strategic use of a deep, dark blue as a primary accent and background color, providing high contrast for white text and creating a sense of depth and professionalism.

The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, maintaining its full size and content. The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content.
Benefit-driven feature sections are structured as numbered steps, each with a concise description and a subtle illustrative element, guiding the user through a process.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header navigation that retains its full height and styling upon scroll, ensuring consistent access to site links.
Create a hero section where the background image scrolls at a slightly slower rate than the foreground text and call-to-action, producing a subtle parallax depth effect.
Structure content into distinct, full-width sections that simply reveal by scrolling into the viewport, relying on static hierarchy rather than scroll-triggered entrance animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear, legible sans-serif body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and interactive elements, sharp corners for main content blocks and section edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with an airy hero section and a slightly denser, structured feature grid.

standout: This site stands out with its confident use of a deep, rich blue as a primary brand color, creating a professional yet approachable feel. The clear, step-by-step presentation of complex financial services, combined with the subtle hero parallax, makes the site feel both trustworthy and engaging without being overly flashy.
